title: Great once you get past setup
review: Onboarding is painful but once your team is active the analytics are excellent. The trial activation email helped us.

title: Complex for small teams
review: The setup wizard is overwhelming for a 5-person team. We almost gave up in the first run.

title: Love the reports
review: Reports are fast and the export to CSV works. We cancelled our old BI tool.

title: Digest emails ignored
review: Weekly digest is generic. I never read it. Mobile app would be better for alerts.

title: Slack integration please
review: We asked for Slack alerts twice. Our ops team lives in Slack, not in your app.

title: Pricey for what we use
review: We pay for seats we do not use. Pricing tiers are confusing after the trial.

title: Second month dip
review: Value is clear in month 1, unclear in month 2. We considered cancelling.

title: Push notifications would help
review: We miss important report thresholds. Push notifications on mobile would prevent fires.

title: Support is fast
review: Support answered our GDPR questions quickly once we asked. Product docs lack it.

title: Too many clicks to share
review: Sharing reports with the board takes 6 clicks and requires an admin. Annoying.

title: Setup took a day
review: The onboarding wizard took a full day with our finance team. Too complex.

title: Solid analytics
review: Best-in-class reporting once activated. The funnel reports are our weekly ritual.

title: Would love SSO
review: SSO would remove our biggest blocker for rolling out company-wide.

title: Deprecate old export already
review: The legacy CSV export is broken and support keeps blaming us. Migrate us properly.
